static_reservations.formula: 12pixels *12 tensor-piece coefficient*(8^2+16^2+32^2). For these fixed cardinal phases each nonempty pixel has at most four covered x pieces and three y pieces. Empty pixels generate0.

convergence_scope: Compare successive fixed orders without tuning; no full-image/radiance/fidelity inference. Empty component is reported separately.
